data.narrative:
Sunflower Labs is a Series B-stage drone and autonomous systems company that has raised $41.7M to date. The broader Drones & Autonomous sector comprises eight private peers, including Elroy Air, Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, and Archer Aviation; no public comparables exist in this narrow subsector.

Valuation analysis relies on a single applicable method due to data constraints. The stage-progression approach applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier—typical for Series B advancement—to the $42M total raised proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $79M. A peer-median approach was not viable; while five same-sector peers exist, fewer than three meet the narrow filters of matching stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier. Applying an all-sector median would introduce material noise.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $67M (low) to $91M (high), centered on $79M. This range reflects reasonable uncertainty bands around the single applicable method. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue or unit-economics data, limited peer visibility into same-stage comparable transactions, and insufficient granularity within the Drones & Autonomous subsector to support peer-based triangulation. Any valuation in this range should be stress-tested against operational milestones, capital efficiency, and narrower peer data as it becomes available.
